flowchart LR
    PL["the platform"] -->|"placed, paid, canceled, refunded"| OMS["the OMS order record"]
    WMS["the WMS"] -->|"shipped, split, tracking number"| OMS
    CAR["carrier via shipping service"] -->|"out for delivery, delivered"| OMS
    RP["the returns portal"] -->|"return received, refund issued"| OMS
    OMS -->|"order events"| NS["notification service"]
    NS -->|"e-mail, SMS, WhatsApp, app"| CUST["the customer"]
    OMS -->|"one status"| SP["order status page"]
    OMS -->|"one status"| SV["service view in the helpdesk"]
    CUST -->|"cancel, change address, start a return"| OMS

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as the customer
    participant PL as the platform
    participant IP as the iPaaS flow
    participant WMS as the WMS
    participant PN as PostNL
    participant ERP as the ERP
    WMS->>IP: Shipment confirmed, fleece, tracking number, 7 Dec
    IP->>PL: Order fulfilled, tracking attached
    PN-->>PL: Delivered, 8 Dec
    PL-->>C: Your order was delivered
    C->>PL: Where are the socks, 11 tickets
    Note over WMS: Order still In picking, socks on replenishment
    Note over ERP: Not invoiced, waiting for order complete
    WMS->>IP: Shipment confirmed, socks, 14 Dec
    IP->>PL: Second tracking number
    WMS->>ERP: Order complete, invoice

stateDiagram-v2
    state "Placed and paid" as S1
    state "Sent to warehouse" as S2
    state "Accepted by warehouse" as S3
    state "Label printed" as S4
    state "Handed to carrier" as S5
    S1 --> S2: fulfillment order created
    S2 --> S3: warehouse accepts
    S3 --> S4: picked and packed
    S4 --> S5: carrier scan
    note right of S1: cancel and address change by the customer
    note right of S3: cancel becomes a request to the warehouse
    note right of S5: only a return remains
